title: Gaze Dwell Detection
description: Gaze Dwell Detection is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Detects when the eyes rest on one element long enough to signal real attention. Fixations are clustered from the raw gaze stream; a dwell is declared when the cluster radius stays under 1 degree for the dwell threshold. It takes gaze point stream and produces dwell events with target element. Tunable parameters: dwell threshold 300–1200 ms. Guarantee: dwells shorter than the threshold are never reported.

fields.mechanism: Fixations are clustered from the raw gaze stream; a dwell is declared when the cluster radius stays under 1 degree for the dwell threshold.
fields.guarantees: dwells shorter than the threshold are never reported

title: Heart-Rate Load Index
description: Heart-Rate Load Index is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Turns heart-rate variability into a live cognitive-load score. Inter-beat intervals are windowed and the RMSSD is normalized against the user's resting baseline to produce a 0–1 load score. It takes PPG or ECG stream, resting baseline and produces load score 0–1. Tunable parameters: window 30–120 s. Guarantee: the score never uses another person's baseline.

fields.mechanism: Inter-beat intervals are windowed and the RMSSD is normalized against the user's resting baseline to produce a 0–1 load score.
fields.inputs: PPG or ECG stream, resting baseline
fields.guarantees: the score never uses another person's baseline

title: Posture Shift Counting
description: Posture Shift Counting is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Counts posture shifts as a proxy for restlessness during long sessions. Shifts are detected from accelerometer variance crossing a threshold; each crossing increments the shift counter for the session. It takes accelerometer stream and produces shift count, shift rate. Tunable parameters: variance threshold tuned per device. Guarantee: a single continuous motion counts once, not repeatedly.

fields.mechanism: Shifts are detected from accelerometer variance crossing a threshold; each crossing increments the shift counter for the session.
fields.guarantees: a single continuous motion counts once, not repeatedly

title: Blink-Rate Fatigue Watch
description: Blink-Rate Fatigue Watch is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Watches blink rate for the rise that precedes fatigue. Blinks are detected from the eye-aspect ratio; the rate per minute is compared against the user's alert baseline. It takes eye landmark stream and produces fatigue flag. Tunable parameters: alert if rate rises 50% over baseline. Guarantee: flags require 3 consecutive elevated minutes.

fields.mechanism: Blinks are detected from the eye-aspect ratio; the rate per minute is compared against the user's alert baseline.
fields.parameters: alert if rate rises 50% over baseline

title: Attention Heat Overlay
description: Attention Heat Overlay is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Paints a live heat map of where attention has been over the last minute. Dwell points are accumulated into a coarse grid with exponential decay so recent attention glows brightest. It takes dwell events and produces grid of attention weights. Tunable parameters: grid 24×16, decay half-life 20 s. Guarantee: stale attention fades below 1% within two minutes.

fields.mechanism: Dwell points are accumulated into a coarse grid with exponential decay so recent attention glows brightest.
fields.guarantees: stale attention fades below 1% within two minutes

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Distraction Event Logging
description: Distraction Event Logging is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Logs every attention break with its cause so patterns can be reviewed later. A break is logged when focus leaves the task region for longer than the grace period, with the landing region recorded. It takes task region, dwell events and produces break log entries. Tunable parameters: grace period 2–5 s. Guarantee: breaks are timestamped to the millisecond.

fields.mechanism: A break is logged when focus leaves the task region for longer than the grace period, with the landing region recorded.
fields.guarantees: breaks are timestamped to the millisecond

title: Focus Session Scoring
description: Focus Session Scoring is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Scores a whole work session from its focus and distraction record. The score blends focused minutes, break count, and recovery speed into one 0–100 number with an explanation. It takes session event log and produces session score, breakdown. Tunable parameters: weights: focus 60, breaks 25, recovery 15. Guarantee: identical event logs always score identically.

title: Adaptive UI Dimming
description: Adaptive UI Dimming is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Dims everything outside the focus region when attention is locked in. The focus element is highlighted while siblings fade to 40% opacity; the effect eases in over 300 ms. It takes focused element and produces dimmed interface. Tunable parameters: fade 0–60%. Guarantee: the focused element itself is never dimmed.

title: Break Nudge Timing
description: Break Nudge Timing is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Suggests a break at the moment fatigue signals peak, not on a fixed clock. The nudge fires when the fatigue index crosses its threshold and the user is between tasks, never mid-action. It takes fatigue index, task boundaries and produces break suggestion. Tunable parameters: snooze 10 min. Guarantee: nudges never interrupt an active keystroke or gesture.

fields.mechanism: The nudge fires when the fatigue index crosses its threshold and the user is between tasks, never mid-action.
fields.guarantees: nudges never interrupt an active keystroke or gesture

title: Calibration Routine
description: Calibration Routine is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Learns the user's personal baselines in a two-minute guided routine. The routine walks the user through rest, reading, and focus states and stores per-state baselines for every signal. It takes guided routine completion and produces personal baselines. Tunable parameters: routine length 120 s. Guarantee: baselines are never shared off-device.

fields.mechanism: The routine walks the user through rest, reading, and focus states and stores per-state baselines for every signal.

title: Multi-Signal Fusion
description: Multi-Signal Fusion is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Fuses gaze, heart rate, and posture into one attention verdict. Each signal votes focused or not with a confidence; a weighted vote decides, with gaze carrying the most weight. It takes signal votes and produces fused verdict. Tunable parameters: gaze 50, heart 30, posture 20. Guarantee: a single noisy signal can never flip the verdict alone.

fields.mechanism: Each signal votes focused or not with a confidence; a weighted vote decides, with gaze carrying the most weight.
fields.guarantees: a single noisy signal can never flip the verdict alone

title: Privacy-Preserving Mode
description: Privacy-Preserving Mode is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Keeps every biometric sample on the device and exports only aggregate states. Raw streams are processed in memory; only the derived state string leaves the module, never the samples. It takes raw biometric streams and produces state strings. Tunable parameters: retention 0 s for raw data. Guarantee: no raw sample is ever written to disk.

fields.mechanism: Raw streams are processed in memory; only the derived state string leaves the module, never the samples.
fields.guarantees: no raw sample is ever written to disk

title: Team Focus Dashboard
description: Team Focus Dashboard is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Shows a team's aggregate focus trend with no individual data exposed. Individual states are averaged into a team trend line; the dashboard refuses to render groups smaller than five. It takes team state strings and produces aggregate trend. Tunable parameters: min group size 5. Guarantee: individuals are never identifiable in the output.

fields.mechanism: Individual states are averaged into a team trend line; the dashboard refuses to render groups smaller than five.

title: Flow-State Detection
description: Flow-State Detection is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Detects flow state from the combination of steady gaze, stable heart rate, and zero shifts. All three signals must hold their flow pattern for five minutes before the state is declared. It takes fused signal stream and produces flow-state events. Tunable parameters: hold time 5 min. Guarantee: flow is never declared from a single signal.

fields.mechanism: All three signals must hold their flow pattern for five minutes before the state is declared.

title: Session Replay
description: Session Replay is a focus-tracking ability in the Biometric Focus Tracking database. Replays a session's attention timeline so the user can see exactly where focus went. Events are stored as a compact timeline and rendered as a scrubable bar with dwell, break, and flow markers. It takes session event log and produces replay timeline. Tunable parameters: 1 ms resolution. Guarantee: the replay always matches the original log exactly.

fields.mechanism: Events are stored as a compact timeline and rendered as a scrubable bar with dwell, break, and flow markers.
fields.guarantees: the replay always matches the original log exactly
